text:
Every Layer8Culture Radio session starts the same quiet way.

Image. Animate. Music. Publish.

A still studio scene becomes a calm, looping world — then we score it in warm Afrofuturist lo-fi and send it out to builders working through the morning, the night, and everything between.

Where technology meets culture.

Technology has seven layers. We're the eighth.

Follow @Layer8CultureRadio — the Focus Room is open 24/7.

The mood is calm, premium, focused, and loop-friendly, with a balanced electric-blue and warm amber lighting palette.
